releases.body:
Initial public release of the opencode TUI plugin that deletes only the last assistant message of the current session, without reverting file changes.

- Palette command + `/delete-last` slash, optional keybind
- Guards: session not busy, is-last-message, no compaction summary, stale-target re-validation
- 90 tests (pure + flow + real-SDK contract + artifact)
- Install: `tui.json` → `plugin: ["opencode-delete-messages"]`

Published on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-delete-messages
